# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Overview

> 17 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview.md): The Claude API includes the following APIs:
- [How to use beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers.md): To access beta features, include the `anthropic-beta` header in your API requests:
- [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors.md): The API follows a predictable HTTP error code format:
- [Service details](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/claude-platform-on-aws-iam-actions.md): The service defines 71 actions. Actions follow the AWS `VerbNoun` convention and use verb discipline so that `Get*` and `List*` wildcards produce a clean read-only boundary.
- [Inbound IP addresses](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/ip-addresses.md): These are the IP addresses where Anthropic services receive incoming connections.
- [About rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits.md): Once you reach your tier's spend cap, API usage pauses until 00:00 UTC on the first day of the next month, unless you request a higher limit sooner.
- [Standard Tier](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/service-tiers.md): The standard tier is the default service tier for all API requests. The API prioritizes these requests alongside all other requests with best-effort availability.
- [supported-regions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/supported-regions.md)
- [Version history](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/versioning.md): Anthropic recommends using the latest API version whenever possible. Previous versions are considered deprecated and may be unavailable for new users.
- [Admin](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin.md): Retrieve information about the organization associated with the authenticated API key.
- [Beta](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta.md): Verifies the webhook signature from the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` headers using your webhook signing key, then parses the payload into an event.
- [Completions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/completions.md): [Legacy] Create a Text Completion.
- [Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/compliance.md): List compliance activities for the authenticated tenant.
- [Files](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/files.md): Upload File
- [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages.md): Send a structured list of input messages with text and/or image content, and the model will generate the next message in the conversation.
- [Models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Skills](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/skills.md): Create Skill
